label: prop:frobenius-pairing-unique
title: Uniqueness of the Frobenius pairing
html:
Proposition. Uniqueness of the Frobenius pairing

The Frobenius pairing is canonical up to overall scale. Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum universe with A simple. Any two non-degenerate Frobenius forms \int_A^{(1)}, \int_A^{(2)} differ by an invertible scalar:

  \int_A^{(2)} \;=\; c  \int_A^{(1)}
  \qquad\text{for some } c \in \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}).

The induced Frobenius pairings \langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle_i = \int_A^{(i)} \circ \mu differ by the same scalar.
